items.source:
Environment property that can be used to override when auto-configuration is
enabled.
items.translation: 可用于覆盖自动配置启用时的环境属性。

items.source: Exclude specific auto-configuration classes such that they will never be applied.
items.translation: 排除特定的自动配置类，使其永远不会被应用。

items.source:
Exclude specific auto-configuration class names such that they will never be
applied.
items.translation: 排除特定的自动配置类名称，使其永远不会被应用。

items.source: Auto-configuration classes are regular Spring @Configuration beans. They are located using ImportCandidates. Generally auto-configuration beans are @Conditional beans (most often using @ConditionalOnClass and @ConditionalOnMissingBean annotations).
items.translation: 自动配置类是常规的 Spring @Configuration bean。它们通过 ImportCandidates 进行定位。通常，自动配置 bean 是 @Conditional bean（通常使用 @ConditionalOnClass 和 @ConditionalOnMissingBean 注解）。

items.source: Auto-configuration tries to be as intelligent as possible and will back-away as you define more of your own configuration. You can always manually exclude() any configuration that you never want to apply (use excludeName() if you don't have access to them). You can also exclude them through the spring.autoconfigure.exclude property. Auto-configuration is always applied after user-defined beans have been registered.
items.translation: 自动配置会尽可能智能，并随着您定义更多自定义配置而逐步退让。您可以始终手动 exclude() 任何您不希望应用的配置（如果您无法访问它们，请使用 excludeName()）。您也可以通过 spring.autoconfigure.exclude 属性来排除它们。自动配置总是在用户定义的 Bean 注册之后应用。

items.source: The package of the class that is annotated with @EnableAutoConfiguration, usually through @SpringBootApplication, has specific significance and is often used as a 'default'. For example, it will be used when scanning for @Entity classes. It is generally recommended that you place @EnableAutoConfiguration (if you're not using @SpringBootApplication) in a root package so that all sub-packages and classes can be searched.
items.translation: 带有 @EnableAutoConfiguration 注解的类所在的包，通常通过 @SpringBootApplication 实现，具有特定意义，并常用作“默认”包。例如，在扫描 @Entity 类时就会使用它。一般建议将 @EnableAutoConfiguration（如果您未使用 @SpringBootApplication）放置在根包中，以便搜索所有子包和类。

items.source: When using @SpringBootApplication, the auto-configuration of the context is automatically enabled and adding this annotation has therefore no additional effect.
items.translation: 使用@SpringBootApplication时，上下文的自动配置会自动启用，因此添加此注解没有额外效果。
